# Source: Stamnos (Mixing Jar)

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Stamnos (Mixing Jar)
- **Artist / culture:** Attributed to the Chicago Painter Greek; Athens
- **Date:** about 450 BCE
- **Style:** high classical
- **Classification:** vessel
- **Department:** Arts of Greece, Rome, and Byzantium
- **AIC artwork ID:** 177
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/177
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/677cb9ce-8e4c-119a-711e-9b5a98c834d9/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Festival

## Extracted source palette

`#E8E8E8, #C8C8C8, #181818, #A8A8A8, #382828, #885838, #C87838, #584838`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#F5F5F5`
- `surface`: `#FCFCFC`
- `on_surface`: `#0F0F11`
- `primary`: `#C87838`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#382828`
- `surface_variant`: `#D9D9DA`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#0F0F11`
- `outline`: `#B5B5B5`
- `error`: `#C87838`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `comic-neue` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `20dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `17.56:1`, surface `18.66:1`
- Variant contrast: `13.57:1`
- Control contrast: `5.77:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
